name: self-test
description: FULL END-TO-END SELF-TEST — no real service needed. Signs up on the local toy signup site (tests/toy-signup-site/server.js, http://127.0.0.1:8898): fills email, receives the verification code via the mock ImprovMX inbox API, submits it, captures the session cookie. Exercises every critical path: tabs.open, form.wait, form.fill (React-safe), form.eval (chrome.debugger CDP), the shared email chunk (email-auth btoa + retry + generic extractionJs), cookies.getAll, and template substitution. Start the toy server first: node tests/toy-signup-site/server.js — then run this preset.

inputs.extractionJs: (args) => { try { if (args.manualCode) return { code: String(args.manualCode).trim(), source: 'manual' }; const status = Number(args.status) || 0; if (status === 401 || status === 403) return { code: null, fatal: true, error: 'email API unauthorized (HTTP ' + status + ') — check the emailWorkerToken input' }; const data = JSON.parse(args.body); const rows = data.results || data.logs || []; const sinceMs = Math.max(0, (Number(args.sinceMs) || 0) - (Number(args.graceMs) || 120000)); const recipient = (args.email || '').toLowerCase(); const CODEISH = /(code|verify|verification|login|log[- ]?in|passcode|password|confirm|signup|sign[- ]?up|otp|one[- ]?time|security)/i; let best = null; let sawCodeish = false; for (const row of rows) { const subject = row.subject || ''; const to = ((row.to_address || (row.recipient && row.recipient.email) || '') + '').toLowerCase(); if (recipient && to && to !== recipient) continue; let ts = row.created || 0; if (!ts && row.received_at) ts = Date.parse(row.received_at) || 0; if (sinceMs && ts && ts < sinceMs) continue; if (!CODEISH.test(subject)) continue; sawCodeish = true; if (!best || ts > best.ts) best = { ts: ts, subject: subject, id: row.id, text: (row.text_body || '').trim() }; } if (!best) return { code: null, reason: sawCodeish ? 'code email older than sinceMs window' : (rows.length ? 'no code email newer than sinceMs for this recipient' : 'no emails yet'), rowCount: rows.length }; const text = best.text || ''; const bodyMatch = text.match(/\b([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\b/); if (bodyMatch && /^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(bodyMatch[1])) return { code: bodyMatch[1], source: 'body', subject: best.subject.slice(0, 100), emailId: best.id }; const subj = best.subject; const layers = [ /([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\s+is\s+(?:your|the)\b.{0,20}?(?:code|passcode|token)/i, /(?:login|verification|verify|signup|sign[- ]?up|passcode|pass|security|access|one[- ]?time|temporary|auth)\s+(?:code|passcode|token)[^A-Za-z0-9]{0,20}([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\b/i, /\bcode(?:\s+is)?[:\s]+([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\b/i ]; for (const re of layers) { const m = subj.match(re); if (m && /^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(m[1])) return { code: m[1], source: 'subject', subject: subj.slice(0, 100), emailId: best.id }; } if (/(code|verify|verification|login|passcode|confirm|signup|otp|one[- ]?time)/i.test(subj)) { return { code: null, fatal: true, emailId: best.id, subject: subj.slice(0, 100), error: 'The verification email arrived ("' + subj.slice(0, 80) + '") but the code is NOT in the subject and no body was returned — if the provider is ImprovMX (logs API) it is metadata-only by design; switch emailWorkerUrl to a body-capable API (v3-mail worker) or set manualCode' }; } return { code: null, reason: 'newest email is not a code email', subject: subj.slice(0, 100) }; } catch (e) { return { code: null, error: e.message }; } }

steps.function: const btns = document.querySelectorAll('div[role="button"]'); for (const b of btns) { if (b.innerText.trim() === 'Continue') { b.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false };

(args) => { const t = (args.token || '').trim(); if (!t) return { ok: false, error: 'emailWorkerToken input is empty — set it in the popup config panel (Email API token)' }; if (/^(basic|bearer)\s+/i.test(t)) return { header: t }; try { return { header: 'Basic ' + btoa(t) }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: 'cannot build Authorization header (non-Latin1 token?): ' + e.message }; } }
const btns = document.querySelectorAll('div[role="button"]'); for (const b of btns) { if (b.innerText.trim() === 'Continue') { b.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false };

return new Promise((resolve) => { const check = () => { const url = window.location.href; if (url.includes('/welcome')) { resolve({ redirected: true, url }); return; } setTimeout(check, 500); }; check(); });

(args) => { const cookies = args.cookies || []; const map = {}; for (const c of cookies) map[c.name] = c.value; return { ok: !!map.toy_session, session: map.toy_session || '', email: (args.email || '') }; }

steps.message: 🎉 Self-test complete — signup + email verification + session capture all work!
